== Contact ==
'''Contact''' or 'making contact' happens in the following exchanges:

Activates the victims on contact effects:
* Melee attacking a unit with physical damage while being adjacent, including diagonally.
** Using reach to attack from further away will not trigger contact effects.
* Throwing a unit. <!--Many many enemy abilities-->
<details>
<summary>Throw abilities</summary>
* {{a|Antler Swipe}}
* {{a|Gang Up}}
* {{a|Hip Toss}}
* {{a|Hurl}}
* {{a|Monkey Toss}}
* {{a|Rough Toss}}
* {{a|Suplex}}
* {{a|Toss}}
* {{i|Big Spring}}
</details>

Activates both units on contact effects:
* Units being knocked into each other.
* Trampling a unit.
* Jumping on a unit.

==== Interactions ====
For a list of which effects trigger on contact, see [[List of effects that trigger on contact]]

== Backstab ==
'''Backstabs''' are a damage mechanic, in which units with a back receive 25% more damage<sup>(rounded down)</sup> when hit into the back.
* Minimum damage increase of 1.
* Only {{icon|physical damage}} can backstab.
* Downed units cannot be backstabbed.
* Certain units do not have a back, such as most {{icon|object|objects}}.
** For a full list, see: [[:Category:units that can't be backstabbed]]

== Critical hit ==
'''Critical hits''' or simply "Crits" are a mechanic where damage (or healing) is increased by the crit damage multiplier of that unit.

The default crit damage is +100%, resulting in double, with some effects being able to increase it.<br>
Any increases also increase the effectiveness of crit healing.

The chance to perform a critical hit is determined by the [[Crit Chance|crit chance]] of the unit. <br>
For enemies this is almost always 0.<br>

Only {{icon|physical damage}} and physical healing can randomly crit and are affected by the crit damage multiplier.
* Magic damage crits are always only 2x. This may be a bug.

The damage is increased after all other calculations and damage reductions, allowing you to deal 2 damage in cases where damage is limited to 1.
